explanation: events_* reads every daily table whose name matches, and the filter on _TABLE_SUFFIX, the part of the name after events_, limits the tables read to October's 31. A filter on event_date gives the same count, but it is a column inside the tables, so every day's table is read first. The suffix is text such as 20251001, so a dashed range keeps no table, and the export has no single events table: in this course the days are stacked into one only for DuckDB.
